description: Signed ~15-minute download link (zip) for a finished wake word — the user’s own (order_id) or a marketplace one they own or that is free (listing_id) — with install steps for omahey (Omarchy) and Ania Player. Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

listing_id.description: Listing id from search_marketplace (or search_avatars for avatars).

order_id.description: Wake-word order id from create_wake_word or wake_word_status.

name: download_wake_word
title: Download a wake word
